text:
Sam (Sales): Heads-up: ZenithHealth enabled log export in POC and can't see logs in the Console; they're also hitting occasional 503s. Ravi, can you paste what you're seeing?

Ravi (Zenith): We flip the drain on and about 30% of payloads return 503. Console shows empty stream for the last hour despite sidecar saying "delivered". Example sidecar lines: 
```
2026-07-09T11:02:12Z info="batch_sent" status=200 req=zh-111 trace=9a1f2c
2026-07-09T11:02:15Z error="upstream timeout" status=503 req=zh-112 trace=9a1f2d
```

Export Bot: Alert: export-gateway anomalies for `zenith-poc` - 503 rate ~320 rps, delivery-confirm mismatch. Ticket POC-441 created.

Olivia (SRE): Two things to check: 1) Content-Encoding mismatch causing gateway to accept then fail upstream, 2) our console-side ingestion filter may be dropping events if they don't include the required `source` field. Can you share the batch schema?

Ravi (Zenith): We're sending arr of events with fields {timestamp,message,request_id,trace_id,user_id}. No `source` top-level.

Marta (Solutions): If console ingestion expects `source: app` or `service: zenith-api` we might silently drop. Quick workaround: set pipeline `drop_if_missing=false` for their project and add `source` in their sidecar env: `DEFAULT_SOURCE=zenith-api`. Also reduce batch_size from 600->250 to avoid timeouts.

Imran (Security): Also note Zenith is HIPAA scoped for this POC; PHI (patient_id, notes) must be redacted before export. Provide a sample scrub step with jq + sha256: 
```
jq '(.events[] .patient_id) |= ("sha256:" + (.|tostring | @base64))' batch.json > scrubbed.json
```
I'll follow up with the formal HIPAA checklist.

Olivia (SRE): I tweaked the ingestion policy for `zenith-poc` to accept missing `source` and to log dropped counts. I also applied a temporary export_rate_limit=700 and enabled a 10m elevated-burst window. Monitoring: https://console.redwood/internal/exports/zenith-poc (internal).

Ravi (Zenith): After adding DEFAULT_SOURCE and lowering batch size the 503s dropped. Console now shows events and trace links (trace 9a1f2c). Thanks.

Sam (Sales): Sales note: include a POC addendum for HIPAA handling + 1 week free export egress. If they go to Dedicated, we need to quote sustained egress and a secure export pipeline.

Imran (Security): I'll attach the HIPAA answers and the scrub script to POC-441. Also recommend using customer-managed KMS for Dedicated.

Export Bot: Ticket POC-441 status -> mitigated (owner Olivia).

Sam (Sales): Next steps: Marta to send patched sidecar snippet (env + curl), Imran to upload sec docs, Olivia to keep watch 24h. Ravi any remaining blockers? :thumbsup:

Ravi (Zenith): All good for now. Will reopen if anything else pops up.
